=== linux-x64
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=
CXXFLAGS=-fPIC
CFLAGS=-fPIC
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=()
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=()
=== linux-musl-x64
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=
CXXFLAGS=-fPIC
CFLAGS=-fPIC
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=()
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=()
=== linux-armhf
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=
CROSS_HOST=arm-linux-gnueabihf
CROSS_PREFIX=arm-linux-gnueabihf
CXXFLAGS=-fPIC
CFLAGS=-fPIC
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE={ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/toolchain/armhf.cmake")
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="--cross-file" [1]="{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/toolchain/armhf-meson.ini")
--- toolchain/armhf-meson.ini
[binaries]
c = 'arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc'
cpp = 'arm-linux-gnueabihf-g++'
ar = 'arm-linux-gnueabihf-ar'
strip = 'arm-linux-gnueabihf-strip'
pkg-config = 'pkg-config'
[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'arm'
cpu = 'armv7'
endian = 'little'
[properties]
pkg_config_libdir = '{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps/lib/pkgconfig'
needs_exe_wrapper = true
[built-in options]
c_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps/include']
cpp_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps/include']
c_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps/lib']
cpp_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps/lib']
--- toolchain/armhf.cmake
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Linux)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR arm)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER arm-linux-gnueabihf-g++)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_INIT "-mfpu=neon")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT "-mfpu=neon")
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH {ROOT}/.work/legacy/linux-armhf/deps)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
=== win-x64
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=
AR=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar
CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-win32
CROSS_HOST=x86_64-w64-mingw32
CROSS_PREFIX=x86_64-w64-mingw32
CXX=x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-win32
NM=x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm
RANLIB=x86_64-w64-mingw32-ranlib
STRIP=x86_64-w64-mingw32-strip
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE={ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/toolchain/windows.cmake")
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="--cross-file" [1]="{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/toolchain/windows-meson.ini")
--- toolchain/windows-meson.ini
[binaries]
c = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-win32'
cpp = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-win32'
ar = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar'
strip = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-strip'
windres = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres'
pkg-config = 'pkg-config'
[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'
[properties]
pkg_config_libdir = '{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps/lib/pkgconfig'
needs_exe_wrapper = true
[built-in options]
c_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps/include']
cpp_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps/include']
c_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps/lib']
cpp_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps/lib']
--- toolchain/windows.cmake
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Windows)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR x86_64)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++)
set(CMAKE_RC_COMPILER x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH {ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-x64/deps)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
=== win-arm64
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=
AR=aarch64-w64-mingw32-ar
CC=aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang
CROSS_HOST=aarch64-w64-mingw32
CROSS_PREFIX=aarch64-w64-mingw32
CXX=aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang++
CXX_RT_LIB=-l:libc++.a
NM=aarch64-w64-mingw32-nm
RANLIB=aarch64-w64-mingw32-ranlib
STRIP=aarch64-w64-mingw32-strip
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE={ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/toolchain/windows.cmake")
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="--cross-file" [1]="{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/toolchain/windows-meson.ini")
--- toolchain/windows-meson.ini
[binaries]
c = 'aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang'
cpp = 'aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang++'
ar = 'aarch64-w64-mingw32-ar'
strip = 'aarch64-w64-mingw32-strip'
windres = 'aarch64-w64-mingw32-windres'
pkg-config = 'pkg-config'
[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'aarch64'
cpu = 'aarch64'
endian = 'little'
[properties]
pkg_config_libdir = '{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps/lib/pkgconfig'
needs_exe_wrapper = true
[built-in options]
c_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps/include']
cpp_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps/include']
c_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps/lib']
cpp_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps/lib']
--- toolchain/windows.cmake
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Windows)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR ARM64)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER aarch64-w64-mingw32-clang++)
set(CMAKE_RC_COMPILER aarch64-w64-mingw32-windres)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH {ROOT}/.work/legacy/win-arm64/deps)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
=== android-arm64
ANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a
ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/android-ndk
ANDROID_TRIPLE=aarch64-linux-android
API=28
AR=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-ar
CC=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android28-clang
CROSS_HOST=aarch64-linux-android
CXX=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android28-clang++
LDFLAGS=-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384
NM=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-nm
RANLIB=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-ranlib
STRIP=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-strip
TOOLCHAIN=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64
declare -a CMAKE_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=/opt/android-ndk/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake" [1]="-DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a" [2]="-DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-28")
declare -a MESON_CROSS_ARGS=([0]="--cross-file" [1]="{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/toolchain/android-meson.ini")
--- toolchain/android-meson.ini
[binaries]
c = '/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android28-clang'
cpp = '/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android28-clang++'
ar = '/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-ar'
strip = '/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-strip'
pkg-config = 'pkg-config'
[host_machine]
system = 'android'
cpu_family = 'aarch64'
cpu = 'aarch64'
endian = 'little'
[properties]
pkg_config_libdir = '{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/deps/lib/pkgconfig'
needs_exe_wrapper = true
[built-in options]
c_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/deps/include']
cpp_args = ['-I{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/deps/include']
c_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/deps/lib']
cpp_link_args = ['-L{ROOT}/.work/legacy/android-arm64/deps/lib']
=== android-x64

ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/android-ndk

AR=/opt/android-ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-ar
